scope: Native checks of the weekly-policy change set; exact publishing commit is available in Git file history and its separate CI run.
database: Actual PostgreSQL 18; Linux/PostgreSQL 17 Docker proof is separate CI.

browser.integration: Actual React/Spring/PostgreSQL and Chromium; no service/browser mocks

restricted_policy_restart.integration: Actual fresh HTTP sessions before/after an invoker-owned app-process restart; same database
restricted_policy_restart.limits: Synthetic owned loopback demo. This verifier does not itself restart the process; the invoker must do so.

actual_owned_restart.method: Owned Windows app terminated and awaited before replacement; same database, distinct process. This is not a graceful-zero-exit assertion.

limits: Synthetic loopback demo; fixed UTC weekly window. No new release tag, benchmark, production scale or full December v1 claim.
